data.title: Crypto Skeptic Rashida Tlaib Holds Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs
data.description: Rep. Rashida Tlaib holds between $3,003 and $45,000 in Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs despite voting against the CLARITY Act.
data.keywords: Rashida Tlaib, financial disclosure, The Senate, Schwab Rollover Traditional IRA, CLARITY Act, Schwab Roth Contributory IRA, IBIT, Bitcoin
